latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release introduces the skill for building foundational segmented lists for marketing and sales operations.
- Enables creation of 10 core active (dynamic) lists, including a master sendable list, ICP-based lists, persona lists, engagement and behavioral lists.
- Lists update automatically as contact properties change, supporting real-time segmentation.
- Outlines prerequisites, user requirements interview, and detailed step-by-step instructions for each list.
- Standardizes segmentation to enable faster, more reliable campaign targeting and sales prioritization.
